items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s where I met this alto saxophonist Charlie Holmes

ctx.x: So then you went from Sabby to Phil Edmond and then to Luis Russell?

Not immediately, because I went to Connecticut to play for a while. That’s where I met this alto saxophonist Charlie Holmes, whom had played with Louis Armstrong and Luis Russell. He told Luis Russell about me. Luis Russell had never heard me. He sent me a special delivery letter. We were playing at Martha’s Vineyard, part of Cape Cod there.
With - when you say “we,” who was with you?
